property_summary: For any inputs where _tos is non-empty and the callee contract's transferFrom call succeeds, the reference contract's transfer returns (does not revert) while the mutant inverts the success check and will revert when the callee call succeeds—so the reference never reverts for a successful downstream call but the mutant can.
change_summary: Invert the success check so the call is required to fail (require(!_s)), causing differing return behavior when downstream call succeeds.
